v4_pre_holdout_safety_fix.reason: A non-MTU-aligned fixed BDP can authorize one final packet past the BDP. Counting that packet as post-grant progress could suppress the first-grant retry even when the grant was lost.
fix: The implicit first-grant acknowledgement frontier is one MTU beyond the path BDP.
A coalesced registered flow cannot be proactively released before post-frontier progress confirms its first final grant.

selection_policy: Repeat the unchanged N=15 mechanism gate on a new frozen trace after the safety-only fix. Do not inspect performance before the gate passes and do not alter the configuration after seeing holdout results.

scalability_holdout.required_grant_envelope: G_s(N) <= 3N for every seed and N

scope_limits: The pilot isolates membership changes by disabling remaining-aware progress refresh.
The first-grant gate bounds each new registered flow to one fixed BDP before a grant arrives.
The retry is an implicit first-grant safeguard; it is not a per-update grant acknowledgement protocol.
Passing G<=3N supports only synchronized N<=15 membership traces, not general O(N).
Performance metrics remain sealed until every holdout mechanism admission check passes.
